title: Uncurried ordinary evaluation component before resolution
statement: For any scheme Y, module-sheaf cochain complexes P,F, the single tensor unit O and V=Hom(P,O), suppose f:Tot(F tensor V) to Hom(P,F) satisfies IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation. For p+q=n and n+r=k, apply tensorHomEquiv.symm to the composite of the p,q inclusion, f in degree n and the Hom projection in degrees n,r,k; precompose with the braiding of F^p tensor V^q and P^r. If r+q=0 this equals the associator, dual projection uncurried and identified with the unit, right unitor and transport F^p to F^k. Otherwise it is zero. This statement contains neither a K-injective resolution nor complex-level uncurrying.

source.place: Tags 08DJ (lemma-internal-hom), 08DM and 08DQ; ordinary evaluation localization proof step 2

proof.text: From n+r=k rewrite k as r+n, preserving hnr separately. Apply congrArg to hf p q n r hpq, with the function that applies inverse tensorHomEquiv and precomposes the braiding. Compose that equation with the following cancellation calculation. Split on r+q=0. In the positive case Equiv.symm_apply_apply and SymmetricCategory.symmetry_assoc cancel the equivalence and the two braidings. In the negative case use the monoidal closed structure and monoidal preadditivity supplied by tensorClosed; uncurry_eq, whiskerLeft_zero, comp_zero and zero_comp show the result is zero. Proof irrelevance identifies degree equalities.

theorem schemeOrdinaryEvaluation_uncurried_component (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F
        (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) ⟶
      homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F)
    (hf : IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation Y P F f)
    (p q r n k : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) (hnr : n + r = k) :
    let O := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    let V := homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P O
    let π := Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists.{u, u, u, u} (R := Y.sheaf))
    (β_ (F.X p ⊗ V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (R := Y.sheaf) (P.X r) (F.X p ⊗ V.X q)
        (F.X k)).symm
        (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F V (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ≫
          f.f n ≫ π P F n r k (by omega)) =
    (if h : r + q = 0 then
      (α_ (F.X p) (V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
        F.X p ◁ ((β_ (V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
          (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (R := Y.sheaf) (P.X r) (V.X q)
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).symm
              (π P O q r 0 h ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := Y.sheaf) (𝟙 (P.X r))
                (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0
                  (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).hom)) ≫
        (ρ_ (F.X p)).hom ≫ (F.XIsoOfEq (by omega : p = k)).hom
    else 0)
